title: 67 (six seven)
summary: Gen Alpha / TikTok brainrot catchphrase — yelled for the bit, not a literal code.
originStory: Exploded via TikTok sounds (notably Skrilla’s “Doot Doot (6 7)”) and hallway/copycat energy. Meaning is intentionally fuzzy: the meme is participating in the noise. Heat stays high while schools and FYP keep recycling the gesture + chant.

title: Aura farming
summary: Doing something cool on purpose to collect social points.
originStory: Gaming/stream slang for stacking intangible 'aura' — now used on TikTok whenever someone flexes quietly for the clip.

title: Crash out
summary: Losing it — spiraling or going off after holding it in.
originStory: AAVE that TikTok mainstreamed. ‘Don’t crash out’ is a vibe-check; describes the moment, not a diagnosis.

title: Glazing
summary: Over-the-top praise — riding for someone so hard it gets embarrassing.
originStory: Rap/AAVE slang that TikTok live chats turned into ‘stop glazing.’ Tease or roast depending on tone.

title: Delulu
summary: Delusional — but make it aspirational (or chaotic).
originStory: K-pop and stan Twitter shortened 'delusional' into 'delulu,' often about shipping. Spilled into mainstream as 'delulu is the solulu.'

title: Brainrot
summary: Content so absurd it feels like it rewires your brain.
originStory: Internet-culture label for hyper-online meme loops; often self-aware rather than an insult. TikTok FYP is the main greenhouse.

title: Situationship
summary: More than friends, less than a defined relationship.
originStory: Label for ambiguous romantic bonds. Useful when 'what are we?' has no clean answer yet.

title: alpha
summary: TikTok/internet slang for top-dog / “best” / dominant energy — not mainly the Greek letter.
originStory: Borrowed from pop “alpha male” hierarchy talk, then memed hard on TikTok as a flex or joke about who’s elite. If someone says “she’s alpha,” they mean status/confidence vibe.

title: Skill issue
summary: Gaming roast: the problem isn't the game — it's you.
originStory: Born in competitive gaming chats as a deadpan dismissal of complaints. Migrated to general internet as playful (or petty) roast.

title: Mewing
summary: Tongue-posture trend people claim will change a jawline.
originStory: Looksmaxxing explainers on TikTok. Glow-up curiosity is allowed; it is not medical advice.

title: Mogging
summary: Winning a looks comparison so hard you ‘mog’ the other person.
originStory: Looksmaxxing forums → TikTok/brainrot speech. Often a joke ranking; sometimes a mean dunk.

title: Rizz
summary: Charisma as a verb and a noun — especially flirtation game.
originStory: Short for charisma, popularized by streamer Kai Cenat and Gen Z slang. Oxford named it Word of the Year in 2023.

title: Soft launch
summary: Hinting at a partner online without a full face reveal.
originStory: Social-media dating tactic: blurry photo, hand pic, or 'we' caption before the hard launch.

title: Midterm arc
summary: The chaotic character development week of exams.
originStory: Campus joke framing midterms as an anime arc — sleep debt, library lore, and temporary personality changes.

title: Locked in
summary: Fully focused — no distractions.
originStory: Athlete/serious-mode phrase that crossed into studying and gaming.

title: Yapping
summary: Talking a lot — rambling, oversharing, or excitedly going on.
originStory: Revived as TikTok/stream chat vocabulary. A yapper will not stop talking; often affectionate.

title: Stan
summary: An extremely dedicated fan (noun/verb).
originStory: From Eminem's song to universal fandom language. Can be loving or intense — context matters.

title: Bias
summary: Your favorite member in a group.
originStory: K-pop term that spread to other fandoms: who you vibe with most.

title: Looksmaxxing
summary: Optimizing appearance with routines, tips, and sometimes extremes.
originStory: Forum slang that hit TikTok explainers. Ranges from skincare to controversial 'maxxing' discourse — Trendy explains the term, not the ideology.

title: Bag
summary: Money / winning financially ('secure the bag').
originStory: Accessible hustle slang. Not always literal cash — sometimes any win.

title: Talking stage
summary: Pre-relationship texting limbo.
originStory: The phase of vibes and plans before exclusivity is named. Can last days or months.

title: W
summary: A win — literal or metaphorical.
originStory: Sports scoreboard letter that became universal internet 'that's a W.' Opposite: L.

title: It's giving…
summary: Naming the vibe something is emitting.
originStory: Fashion/stan shorthand: 'it's giving main character' = the energy matches that reference. Flexible and playful.

title: Unspoken rizz
summary: Magnetism without trying — the quiet flex of charm.
originStory: Sibling of 'rizz' that TikTok popularized as the highest form: you don't announce it, people just feel it.

title: Green flag
summary: A wholesome sign someone is emotionally safe.
originStory: Positive cousin of red flags — healthy communication, respect, consistency.

title: Edging
summary: Hovering at the edge of a payoff without finishing — a joke about delay.
originStory: Older slang recycled as a TikTok/stream bit about stretching tension. Casual use is usually the joke, not a how-to.

title: No cap
summary: No lie / for real.
originStory: AAVE-rooted slang that became universal online for emphasizing honesty. Pair with 'cap' for the opposite.

title: L
summary: A loss — take the L.
originStory: Accept the defeat (or roast someone for theirs). Pair with W culture.

title: Bandwidth
summary: Capacity to take on more work (or not).
originStory: Borrowed from tech; now human energy management slang at jobs.

title: OOTL
summary: Out Of The Loop — asking for catch-up.
originStory: Reddit-famous plea that maps perfectly to Trendy's job: bring you up to speed.

title: Artist era
summary: A stylistic chapter defined by looks + sound.
originStory: Fans date their lives by which album era they were in.

title: FR / FRFR
summary: For real — emphasis that you're not joking.
originStory: Stacked 'frfr' intensifies sincerity in chats and comments.

title: NPC energy
summary: Acting like a background character — scripted, predictable, unbothered.
originStory: From gaming's non-player characters. Online, calling someone an 'NPC' implies they lack originality — sometimes self-deprecating.

title: Comeback
summary: A new release era for an artist/group.
originStory: Not a sports return — a scheduled drop with concepts, stages, and timelines.

title: Hard launch
summary: Officially posting your partner for the timeline.
originStory: The full reveal after a soft launch — clear photos, tags, no more mystery.

title: Cooked
summary: Done for — no coming back.
originStory: When a team (or person) is finished. Sibling of 'it's so over.'

title: Async
summary: Not real-time — reply when you can.
originStory: Tech workplace ideal (and sometimes fiction) for timezone-friendly work.

title: NGL
summary: Not Gonna Lie — confession preface.
originStory: Softens whatever comes next; often paired with a spicy opinion or compliment.

title: Roommate lore
summary: The ongoing sitcom of shared living.
originStory: TikTok dorm stories turned everyday roommate quirks into serialized campus content.

title: Ship
summary: Wanting two people together (fictional or real).
originStory: Fandom verb/noun. Keep it respectful — Trendy explains the slang, not the parasocial spiral.

title: Bullish
summary: Optimistic on price / prospects.
originStory: Market term that friends use about careers, albums, and situationships.

title: Sweaty
summary: Trying extremely hard — sometimes too hard.
originStory: Label for tryhard play. Can be respect or mild shade depending on tone.

title: Red flag
summary: A warning sign in dating behavior.
originStory: Everyday metaphor that dating content turned into a checklist language.

title: Circle back
summary: Corporate speak for 'later' — sometimes never.
originStory: Meeting classic. Often gently mocked as delay language.

title: IYKYK
summary: If You Know, You Know — insider shorthand that gates the joke.
originStory: Signals shared context without explaining it. Used in captions, group chats, and product drops to create belonging (or FOMO).

title: Pass/fail energy
summary: Doing the minimum ethical amount to clear the bar.
originStory: Campus cousin of quiet quitting — protect your GPA bandwidth.

title: Bias wrecker
summary: The member who almost steals your #1 spot.
originStory: Playful K-pop drama about divided loyalties.

title: Ship it
summary: Release the thing — perfection can wait.
originStory: Product/eng mantra. Also a personality: bias to action.

title: Clutch
summary: Winning despite terrible odds.
originStory: Esports highlight word that crossed into sports and everyday 'came through' praise.

title: Rizzless
summary: Having zero flirtation game (affectionate roast).
originStory: Opposite of rizz. Often self-deprecating in group chats.

title: The script
summary: Conspiracy joke that the league wrote the ending.
originStory: Fans say 'the script' when outcomes feel too cinematic. Playful paranoia.

title: Side hustle
summary: Extra income project beyond the main job.
originStory: Mainstream money slang for gig/creative income. Neutral: survival or ambition.

title: Beige flag
summary: A quirky trait that's neither red nor green — just oddly specific.
originStory: Dating-TikTok cousin of red/green flags: weird habits that make you go 'huh' without ending the vibe.

title: Touch grass
summary: Go outside. Log off. Reconnect with reality (gently or not).
originStory: Internet shorthand telling someone they're too online. Can be caring advice or a dunk.

title: Group project lore
summary: Someone always ghosts the shared doc.
originStory: Eternal campus meme about unequal labor. Judgment-free tip: set roles early.

title: Stream (as activism)
summary: Coordinated plays to boost charts.
originStory: Fandom labor: playlists, multiple devices, and chart rules discourse.

title: Rug pull
summary: Scam where creators abandon a project and take funds.
originStory: Crypto meme that became general 'they betrayed the vibe' language. Stay skeptical of hype.

title: IDC energy
summary: The vibe of deliberately not caring.
originStory: More than the literal abbrev — a whole posture of chill detachment in comments and captions.

title: The meta
summary: What's currently strongest / most popular strategy.
originStory: Short for metagame. Outside games: 'the meta' = the dominant trend people optimize for.

title: In your era
summary: A hot streak / peak form stretch.
originStory: Athletes and fans narrate seasons as 'eras.' Also lifestyle slang.

title: LGTM
summary: Looks Good To Me — code review approval.
originStory: Engineering shorthand that escaped into design docs and Slack thumbs-up culture.

title: Copium
summary: The imaginary drug of cope — denial as a meme.
originStory: Imageboard/Twitch joke about huffing cope when your team loses or your take flops. Sibling of hopium.

title: Orbiting
summary: Watching stories / liking posts after going quiet.
originStory: Post-ghost behavior: no texts, but still lurking. Confusing on purpose or by habit.

title: Unreleased lore
summary: Leaks, demos, vault tracks fans obsess over.
originStory: Fandom archaeology: unfinished songs become mythology.

title: Broke tax
summary: The hidden extra costs of not having spare cash.
originStory: Culture phrase for how poverty is expensive (fees, replacements). Empathy-first.

title: Underconsumption core
summary: Aesthetic of buying less / using what you have.
originStory: Pushback wave against haul culture on TikTok — celebrating thrift, leftovers, and not needing the new drop.

title: Tilted
summary: Emotionally off after losses — play gets worse.
originStory: Poker → gaming: tilted players make bad decisions. Advice is usually take a break.

title: The curve
summary: Grading relative to classmates — hope and despair.
originStory: When the exam destroys everyone, the curve becomes the protagonist.

title: Run it back
summary: Rematch — or do that season again.
originStory: From pickup games to franchise hopes and friend-group plans.

title: MVP
summary: Minimum Viable Product — ship the smallest useful version.
originStory: Startup classic. Outside tech: 'good enough to learn from.'

title: RN
summary: Right Now — urgency stamp.
originStory: Pairs with plans, moods, and 'where are you rn?' logistics.

title: I'll be offline
summary: Calendar shield for focus / life.
originStory: Remote-work boundary phrase that replaced 'stepping away.'

title: Nerf
summary: When something gets weakened by a patch.
originStory: From Nerf foam toys → game balance speak → any time life makes a thing less strong.

title: Dead week
summary: Pre-finals week that is somehow busier than finals.
originStory: Name varies by school; the sleep schedule does not.

title: Paycheck to paycheck
summary: No buffer — income barely covers bills.
originStory: Relatable finance phrase in culture discourse; judgment-free.

title: Breadcrumbing
summary: Leaving just enough attention to keep someone hopeful.
originStory: Dating discourse term for inconsistent low-effort contact. Not a compliment.

title: Title track
summary: The lead single that defines the era.
originStory: Fandom shorthand for the promoted song on an album cycle.

title: ISTG
summary: I Swear To God — dramatic emphasis.
originStory: Heightens sincerity or frustration in one punchy package.

title: Syllabus week
summary: The fake-chill first week before workload hits.
originStory: Students treat it as a grace period; professors may disagree. Seasonal campus slang.

title: NGMI
summary: Not Gonna Make It — bearish roast.
originStory: Crypto Twitter shorthand for doubting someone's strategy or mindset.

title: Buff
summary: When something gets stronger.
originStory: Opposite of nerf. Also jokingly used for coffee, sleep, or a new haircut.

title: Love bombing
summary: Overwhelming affection early — sometimes manipulative.
originStory: Psychology term that entered dating TikTok. Trendy explains the phrase; context is everything.

title: Send it
summary: Go full commitment — no half measures.
originStory: Action-sports encouragement that became general hype language.

title: OP / ED
summary: Opening / ending songs for anime & shows.
originStory: Anime music fandom shorthand that spilled into general 'this slap' talk.

title: Cringe
summary: Secondhand embarrassment — or a weaponized vibe check.
originStory: Mainstreamed hard in the 2010s; still the default reaction emoji in text form. Often says more about the caller.

title: Commuter core
summary: Campus life without the dorm — bag heavy, train timed.
originStory: Aesthetic/identity for students who live off campus and optimize every minute.

title: WAGMI
summary: We're All Gonna Make It — hopeful group cope.
originStory: Community pep talk abbrev. Sibling of NGMI.

title: Diff
summary: Short for 'difference' — what decided the match.
originStory: Competitive shorthand: 'mid diff' means the mid laner was the gap. Spilled into casual roast culture.

title: R1 / research flex
summary: Campus shorthand for research-heavy university vibes.
originStory: Students joke about R1 grind culture — labs, grants, and coffee.

title: Fancam
summary: Fan-edited video focusing on one performer.
originStory: Concert/clip culture essential — sometimes used as reply-guy chaos on socials.

title: On-call
summary: Your turn to get paged if prod breaks.
originStory: Tech ops reality that non-tech friends hear as 'scary phone job.'

title: Main character energy
summary: Living like the plot revolves around you — cinematic confidence.
originStory: TikTok/IG affirmation meme encouraging people to romanticize their day. Can be empowering or gently roasted as self-centered.

title: ILY / ILYSM
summary: I Love You (So Much) — affection shorthand.
originStory: Texting warmth that scales from friends to partners depending on context.

title: Ghosting
summary: Disappearing without explanation.
originStory: Mainstream dating vocab for sudden silence. Painful, common, still debated as etiquette fail.

title: House money
summary: Playing free — already ahead, so swing big.
originStory: Gambling/sports metaphor for low-risk aggression after a lead.

title: Diamond hands
summary: Holding an asset despite volatility.
originStory: Retail-investing meme for conviction (or stubbornness). Opposite: paper hands.

title: Understood the assignment
summary: Nailed the brief — fashion, joke, or moment.
originStory: Praise phrase from Black Twitter/TikTok for executing a look or bit perfectly.

title: Office hours lore
summary: The mythic quest of actually going to office hours.
originStory: Memes about fearing professors then discovering they're helpful. Campus survival tip dressed as a bit.

title: Buzzer-beater energy
summary: Last-second heroics.
originStory: Basketball term used for any clutch finish in life.

title: Bikeshedding
summary: Debating trivia instead of hard problems.
originStory: From Parkinson's law of triviality — beloved eng meme.

title: Benching
summary: Keeping someone as a backup option.
originStory: Sports metaphor for not starting someone but not cutting them either.

title: Vocal coach reaction
summary: Pro musicians reacting to performances as content.
originStory: YouTube genre that fandoms treat as validation (or debate fuel).

title: Soft save / hard save
summary: Casual vs serious money discipline vibes.
originStory: Internet money-talk remix of soft/hard launch language for budgets.

title: Let him cook
summary: Don’t interrupt — they’re onto something.
originStory: Sports/internet hype phrase. TikTok uses it as a green light to keep going (rant, play, bit).

title: Chronically online
summary: So deep in the internet that IRL references bounce off.
originStory: Descriptor for people whose humor, politics, and slang are shaped by feeds. Often self-applied with a shrug.

title: Roman Empire
summary: The viral bit that men think about Rome 'often' — turned into a culture gag.
originStory: A 2023 TikTok trend asked women how often their partners think about the Roman Empire. Shockingly frequent answers became a meme about hyperfixation. It spawned endless variants ('what's your Roman Empire?').

title: Inting
summary: Intentionally feeding / throwing (or just playing that badly).
originStory: From 'intentional feeding.' Now used whenever someone sabotages a round — on purpose or by accident.

title: Transfer arc
summary: Restarting social + academic plot at a new school.
originStory: Students narrate transferring like a season reboot — scary and hopeful.

title: RTO
summary: Return To Office — mandate drama shorthand.
originStory: Post-pandemic workplace abbrev for going back onsite.

title: We are so back
summary: Sudden optimism swing — twin of “it’s so over.”
originStory: Internet doom/hope oscillation memes; still used constantly in sports and fandom chats.

title: Cuffing season
summary: Fall/winter urge to couple up.
originStory: Seasonal dating meme: colder weather, warmer situationships.

title: Gatekeep (the discography)
summary: Protecting deep cuts from casuals — sometimes playfully.
originStory: Part of the gatekeep/gaslight/girlboss joke triad; in music it means snobbery or care.

title: Paper hands
summary: Selling early under pressure.
originStory: Playful roast in investing chats. Not financial advice — just vocabulary.

title: One-shot
summary: Killed in a single hit — or a take that ends debate.
originStory: Combat slang that became metaphor for anything decisive and sudden.

title: Based
summary: Agreeably unfiltered — approval slang with messy baggage.
originStory: From early internet / Lil B into broader 'I respect that take' energy. Context matters; Trendy keeps it descriptive.

title: FOMO → JOMO
summary: Fear of missing out vs joy of missing out — the pendulum swing.
originStory: FOMO defined social media anxiety; JOMO flipped it into pleasure in staying home. Both still circulate.

title: Superteam
summary: Roster so stacked it feels unfair.
originStory: NBA/football discourse staple; also joke about friend groups.

title: Exit liquidity
summary: Being the buyer someone else sells into.
originStory: Finance jargon that memes use when retail gets dumped on. Educational caution vibes.

title: Sigma
summary: Lone-wolf archetype meme — sometimes serious, often ironic.
originStory: Manosphere-adjacent label that TikTok remixed into jokes, edits, and 'sigma grindset' parody. Tone depends entirely on the poster.

title: HMU
summary: Hit Me Up — invitation to message.
originStory: Classic social abbrev for 'text me' / 'reach out.'

title: Stakeholder sync
summary: Meeting about the meeting's audience.
originStory: Corp calendar filler that became a gentle joke among ICs.

title: Tanking
summary: Losing on purpose for future advantage.
originStory: League strategy discourse that fans apply sarcastically to their own teams.

title: Vibe check
summary: A snap read of whether the energy is good, off, or a little dangerous.
originStory: 2010s internet phrase that never left. TikTok uses it as both a joke stamp and a real ‘is this room OK?’ scan.

title: Ate (and left no crumbs)
summary: Did something exceptionally well.
originStory: Praise slang that crossed into broader TikTok compliments. Use it sincerely — it's celebration, not homework.

title: GG / GG EZ
summary: Good game — or the toxic cousin that gloats after a win.
originStory: 'GG' is polite end-of-match etiquette. 'GG EZ' twists it into a taunt. Many communities auto-mute EZ spam.

title: All-nighter
summary: Pulling a sleepless study/work marathon.
originStory: Classic student slang that never left — now also remote-work coded.

title: AFAIK
summary: As Far As I Know — epistemic humility.
originStory: Useful hedge when sharing info that might be incomplete.

title: To the moon
summary: Hype that a price will rocket.
originStory: Meme optimism. Treat as vibes, not a plan.

title: Very demure, very mindful
summary: Soft-spoken irony for 'I'm being cute/careful on purpose.'
originStory: TikTok creator bit that turned 'demure' into a catchphrase for performative composure — often jokingly.

title: Ratio
summary: When replies/likes dunk on the original post.
originStory: Twitter/X culture: getting ratioed means the crowd disagreed harder than they agreed. Still used beyond that app.

title: Dud game
summary: A star underperforms — off night.
originStory: Broadcast slang that fans reuse in group chats.

title: Gyatt
summary: A loud reaction to someone’s body, especially hips/backside — exaggerated “goddamn.”
originStory: Stream and TikTok slang that became a brainrot shout. Trendy explains the word; it isn’t a rating.

title: TBH
summary: To Be Honest — soft opener for a real take.
originStory: Classic texting abbrev that never left. Often cushions a blunt opinion.

title: Corecore
summary: Edit compilations that feel like an existential moodboard with sad audio.
originStory: A TikTok / YouTube edit style stacking unrelated clips — consumerism, loneliness, late-capitalism vibes — into an emotional gut punch. Named as a parody of endless '-core' aesthetics.

title: AFK
summary: Away From Keyboard — temporarily gone.
originStory: Classic MMO/chat status that still marks a pause in Discords and lobbies.

title: Nah, I'd win
summary: Gojo Satoru defiant-confidence catchphrase from Jujutsu Kaisen — meme swagger (often ironic).
originStory: JJK manga line (Ch. 221 / Ch. 3 callback) that exploded as an exploitable panel and TikTok/anime-Twitter meme in late 2023. Still referenced; peak heat has cooled.

title: Goofy ahh
summary: Playful insult for something silly or unserious.
originStory: Meme-speak intensifier that rode YouTube/TikTok brainrot. Soft roast more than real shade.

title: ATM
summary: At The Moment — time-stamp for your current state.
originStory: Not the cash machine (usually). Quick status update in texts.

title: Fanum tax
summary: Playfully taking a bite of someone else’s food — a ‘tax’ named after streamer Fanum.
originStory: AMP / Kai Cenat circle bit that jumped to TikTok. Friends joke the bite is owed; not a real fee.

title: Synergy
summary: Buzzword for collaboration that sounds fancier than 'team up.'
originStory: Corporate meme fuel. Still appears in decks with a straight face.

title: NPC live
summary: Creators perform scripted loops like game NPCs for gifts.
originStory: Grew from live TikTok bits where creators repeat catchphrases — meme of algorithmic performance.

title: IMO / IMHO
summary: In My (Humble) Opinion — opinion disclaimer.
originStory: Forum classic that still shows up when people want to soften a take.

title: Girl dinner
summary: A snack plate that somehow counts as a meal — vibes over macros.
originStory: Started as a tongue-in-cheek TikTok confession: assembling cheese, crackers, leftover fries, and whatever's in the fridge into a 'meal' with zero plating guilt. It snowballed into a celebration of low-effort eating and a gentle pushback on performative wellness.

title: Quiet quitting
summary: Doing your job — not unpaid ambition overtime.
originStory: Workplace discourse around 2022 that reframed boundaries. Still referenced.

title: Skibidi Toilet
summary: YouTube/TikTok horror-comedy by DaFuq!?Boom! — heads in toilets vs Cameramen; kids also chant “skibidi” as brainrot noise.
originStory: Created by Georgian animator DaFuq!?Boom! (Alexey Gerasimov) in 2023. The series went from YouTube to schoolyard chants and TikTok sounds. “Skibiti” is a common misspelling. Meaning is the series plus the nonsense chant — not a secret dictionary code.

title: SMH
summary: Shaking My Head — mild disbelief.
originStory: Useful when tone needs a sigh, not a paragraph.

title: Bussin
summary: Really good — especially food, but also fits, music, or a moment.
originStory: AAVE praise that TikTok food and fit checks kept alive. Casual ‘this slaps,’ not a technical review.

title: Freshman 15
summary: The (overhyped) first-year weight change myth.
originStory: Older campus phrase still referenced ironically; bodies change for lots of reasons.

title: BRB
summary: Be Right Back — pause signal.
originStory: Ancient chat etiquette that still works in Discords and group chats.

title: Only in Ohio
summary: Catch-all punchline for anything chaotic or cursed.
originStory: Gen Alpha meme treating Ohio as the capital of weird internet energy. Rarely about the actual state.
